baseline_models.mechanism: The transfer verb removes the claimant and the content of his claim from his control; arrival then presents him without the attachments that made the claim substantial.

activation_trace.role: Transfer from a prior holder supplies the dispossession axis for claimant and claim.
Voiced speech supplies the residue explicitly governed by مَا.
Coming and reaching supply the terminal presentation before Us.
Unmixed singularity strips companions, possessions, and comparators from that presentation.

changed_reading.before: A person dies and leaves property behind.
changed_reading.after: The claimant and his voiced claim pass beyond his control, and he appears without the relations or goods on which the claim depended.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inherited مَا يَقُولُ is juxtaposed with the speaker arriving فَرْدًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inheritance lets a claim outlast its holder; the القول branch as belief and the separated-pearl branch of فرد make the claim an inspectable remainder detached from its claimant.

activation_trace.role: Succession supplies survival of an item beyond its prior holder.
A القول as belief or position extends the object beyond its acoustic utterance.
Arrival supplies the moment at which holder and remainder are separately exposed.
A pearl separated in a string supplies the image of a discrete claim severed from its speaker.

changed_reading.before: What he says is a transient sound that remains attached to him.
changed_reading.after: His position becomes a separable remainder that survives for inspection while he arrives as a distinct, unsupported individual.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier first-person expectation of being given wealth and offspring reverses direction in the focus: what he anticipates receiving is inherited away, and the expected beneficiary arrives without it.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance supplies transfer away from the claimant rather than acquisition by him.
His actual coming to Us replaces his forecast of a gift coming to him.
Arrival alone supplies the result of the reversed acquisition.
The voiced assertion supplies the specific antecedent for what he says.
Giving supplies the expected direction of transfer toward the speaker.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material content of the expected gift.
Offspring supplies the relational content that singular arrival removes.

structural_cues: 19:77 and 19:80 repeat saying and coming with opposite persons and directions: he expects to be given, then he comes to Us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies his stated gift, its wealth-and-offspring contents, inheritance, and lone arrival; I connect مَا يَقُولُ to that statement and read the agent reversal as dispossession. A live alternative is that only the assertion, not the named goods, is inherited.

changed_reading.before: The inheritance is a generic transfer after death.
changed_reading.after: It is a pointed reversal of his forecast: the would-be recipient loses title to the very wealth and lineage he expects, then arrives without either.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated phrase مَا يَقُولُ first enters writing that fixes judgment and then enters inheritance; speech therefore survives as a recorded liability whose consequence is extended.

activation_trace.role: Succession supplies custody of a residue after its speaker loses control.
The focus repeats the voiced object that the prior ayah writes.
Written fixation that entails judgment turns utterance into durable evidence.
The exact repeated speech object binds the written record to the inherited remainder.
Continuous lengthening supplies persistence from record into consequence.
Punitive pain identifies the liability attached to the preserved statement.

structural_cues: 19:79-80 repeat مَا يَقُولُ across the sequence write, extend, inherit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, the identical speech phrase, extended punishment, and inheritance; I infer a record-to-liability handoff. The live alternative is that writing and inheritance are parallel acts with no custodial arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: His words are only the content of a boast.
changed_reading.after: The boast becomes a durable evidentiary estate: fixed in writing, retained beyond him, and attached to an extending consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Objects deliberately acquired to reinforce their owners reverse into opposing counterparts; the focus singularity is therefore the endpoint of a failed support system, not merely physical solitude.

activation_trace.role: Unmixed singularity supplies the endpoint after coalition failure.
Deliberate acquisition supplies construction of the support network.
Reinforcement supplies the intended function of the acquired gods.
Submissive worship supplies the relation the supposed supporters repudiate.
Contrary opposition reverses support into an adverse counterparty.

structural_cues: 19:81 gives the purpose لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا; 19:82 negates it and replaces it with ضِدًّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an acquired source of reinforcement and its explicit reversal into opposition; I connect that failed relation to فَرْدًا as the resulting social condition. A live alternative limits the focus solitude to wealth and offspring from 19:77.

changed_reading.before: He arrives alone simply because possessions cannot accompany him.
changed_reading.after: He arrives after a manufactured coalition collapses: intended reinforcers not only fail to accompany him but stand over against him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intercession is the joining of another person to one standing alone, but the context denies ownership of that addition and makes covenant, not possession, its exception.

activation_trace.role: Being unjoined supplies the condition that an intercessor would alter.
Possession and disposal supply the leverage explicitly denied.
An intercessor joining another supplies the precise relational alternative to solitary standing.
A preserved covenant supplies the sole stated basis for that relation.

structural_cues: 19:87 uses a negation-exception construction: no owned intercession, except through a covenant with the Merciful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied ownership, joining intercession, and a covenant exception; I infer that فَرْدًا excludes self-controlled advocacy. The live alternative is that 19:87 states a general rule without specifying this speaker's arrival.

changed_reading.after: Alone also means legally unaugmented: he cannot own a second voice to join his case, and any exception lies outside his claimed assets.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inheritance term opens a genealogical frame, but the later sequence denies that the Merciful acquires a child and recasts every claimant as an arriving servant; false filial attribution is reversed into ownership of claimant and claim.

activation_trace.role: Succession from predecessor to heir supplies the genealogical frame that the context overturns.
False attribution supplies a context-activated scope for what he says.
Saying what is not so identifies the later filial assertion as a false attribution.
Acquisition supplies the alleged divine act toward a child.
Biological offspring supplies the asserted lineage.
Claimed right or affiliation exposes the son statement as an attribution of relation.
Fitness and propriety supply the explicit denial that such acquisition can apply.
Servitude and ownership replace the fabricated filial relation.

structural_cues: 19:88-93 move from saying that the Merciful took a child, through repeated denial, to everyone coming as a servant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inheritance image, repeated child attribution, its denial, and universal servitude; I use inheritance's lineage structure to connect them and read ownership as the reversal. The live alternative is that مَا يَقُولُ refers only to the wealth-and-child boast in 19:77, not the later divine-son claim.

changed_reading.before: The inherited saying concerns only a man's expected estate and descendants.
changed_reading.after: It can also answer speech that fabricates divine lineage: no child succeeds the Merciful; the speakers and their attribution instead return under ownership as servants.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plural cohorts can be gathered or driven toward the same authority, but exhaustive enumeration resolves the collective flow into one-by-one presentation; فَرْدًا names the unit of accounting, not absence of a universal gathering.

activation_trace.role: Coming to Us supplies the destination later shared by every cohort.
One-by-one arrival supplies the unit into which the cohorts are resolved.
Driving and gathering a group supplies collective movement toward one destination.
A delegation approaching authority supplies an honored collective arrival mode.
Driving and expulsion supply the coercive movement of the contrasting cohort.
Reaching a destination supplies the contrasting compelled arrival mode.
Exhaustive numerical survey supplies complete coverage of the gathered population.
Counting the counted supplies explicit unitization within that coverage.
Totality and enclosure prevent individualization from meaning only an exceptional person.
The repeated arrival root confirms the focus movement at universal scope.
The exact repeated singularity confirms one-by-one presentation as the final mode.

structural_cues: 19:85-86 present plural cohorts and contrasting arrival modes; 19:94-95 shift to exhaustive count and repeat ءَاتِيهِ ... فَرْدًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective routing, exhaustive counting, and the exact later repetition of coming alone; I infer a two-stage mechanism of group conveyance followed by individual accounting. The live alternative is that counting expresses knowledge without describing a processing sequence.

changed_reading.before: Coming alone excludes any collective scene.
changed_reading.after: Collective movement and individual presentation coexist: all are mustered in cohorts, but each claim and claimant is finally handled as a single counted case.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats speech as materially load-bearing; it remains anchored in the focus قول and inheritance, while 19:88-90 explicitly moves from a false saying to near-fracture, splitting, and collapse. Render it as a context-driven causal image, not as a lexical meaning of يقول.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَا يَقُولُ is the inherited object.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance supplies persistence of the utterance after control passes from its speaker.
Voiced speech supplies the focus object that acquires structural consequence.
False attribution supplies the later saying from which the rupture sequence proceeds.
Opening and splitting supply the first material response to the saying.
Rending open supplies propagation of the utterance's load through the earth.
Severe breaking and demolition supply the terminal image of structural overload.

changed_reading.before: The saying is inert evidence that merely remains on record.
changed_reading.after: The inherited saying can be carried as an effective load whose false relation nearly tears the surrounding order apart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the fire-stirring branch of ورث rather than ordinary succession; the exact focus root, its speech object, and 19:79's writing and extended punishment keep it anchored. Render only as an explicit branch metaphor, never as the direct translation of نرث.

activation_trace.role: Stirring embers until they ignite supplies an exploratory action image for what is done with the utterance.
Voiced speech supplies the material metaphorically treated as kindling.
Ordered letters and the written object supply preservation before ignition.
Continuous extension supplies duration to the ember-like consequence.
Punitive pain supplies the domain in which the stirred utterance burns.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance passively receives what survives the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the preserved utterance is an ember actively stirred into an extending punitive consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and links littleness, a separated pearl, and a hidden sound; it remains anchored in مَا يَقُولُ, inheritance, and فَرْدًا, with 19:98 ending in no detectable person or whisper. Render as a phonetic-branch activation, not as ordinary morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The saying is inherited while its speaker arrives فَرْدًا.

activation_trace.role: Succession supplies retention of a residue after the claimant is gone.
Littleness and diminution reduce the grand claim to a negligible remainder.
A separated pearl supplies the image of that remainder isolated from its owner.
Dispersal into individuals supplies the disappearance of the claimant's generation as a collective support.
Auditory detection supplies the test under which the remaining claim nearly vanishes.
A hidden low sound supplies the final minimal trace of once-expansive speech.

changed_reading.before: His boast projects abundant wealth, offspring, and social continuation.
changed_reading.after: The boast contracts into one negligible verbal bead: a barely detectable residue retained after claimant, cohort, and support have disappeared.

strongest_changes: 19:77 reverses the expected gift: wealth and offspring move from promised acquisition to inherited loss.
19:79 turns transient speech into a written liability that persists beyond its speaker.
19:81-87 makes lone arrival the collapse of acquired reinforcement and self-owned advocacy.
19:93-95 makes فردًا the unit of exhaustive accounting inside a universal gathering.
summary.what_was_special: The four focus roots form one transfer-and-presentation mechanism: speech asserts acquisition, inheritance reverses title, coming executes presentation, and singularity removes every claimed attachment. Later lineage, intercession, gathering, and exact lexical repetition sharpen distinct readings without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax can foreground either the claimant plus his saying or what is inherited from him; that scope affects how literally the named goods enter the transfer.
The later divine-son claim may directly expand مَا يَقُولُ or may only activate an analogous genealogical reversal.
The fire and ق ل ل readings are packet-licensed exploratory branches, not stable lexical renderings.
